title: Dynamics design of a non-natural transcription factor responding to androst-4-ene-3,17-dione.
authors: Zhao, Ming; Hu, Mengkai; Han, Rumeng; Ye, Chao; Li, Xiangfei; Wang, Tianwen; Liu, Yan; Xue, Zhenglian; Liu, Kun
one_liner_zh: 该文基于分子动力学模拟设计非天然转录因子AdT响应雄烯二酮，涉及TF-DNA结合域组装与配体响应机制，但核心是配体响应而非TF-DNA特异性结合建模，方法可迁移至TF-DNA研究。
abstract: The production of androst-4-ene-3,17-dione (AD) by the steroidal microbial cell factory requires transcription factors (TFs) to participate in metabolic regulation. However, microbial cell factory lacks effective TFs that can respond to AD in its metabolic pathway. Additionally, finding and obtaining natural TFs that specifically respond to AD is a complex and onerous task. In this study, we devised an artificial TF that responds to AD, termed AdT, based on structure-guided molecular dynamics (MD) simulation. According to MD analysis of the conformational changes of AdT after binding to AD, an LBD in which the N- and C-termini exhibited convergence tendencies was used as a microswitch to guide the assembly of a DNA-binding domain lexA, a linker (GGGGS)(2), and a transcription activation domain B42 into an artificial TF. As a proof of design, a AD biosensor was designed and constructed in yeast on the basis of the ligand-binding domain (LBD) of hormone receptor. In addition, the transcription factor activity of AdT was increased by 1.44-fold for its variant F320Y. Overall, we created non-natural TF elements for AD microbial cell factory, and expected that the design TF strategy will be applied to running in parallel to the signaling machinery of the host cell.
abstract_zh: 甾体微生物细胞工厂生产雄甾-4-烯-3,17-二酮（AD）需要转录因子（TFs）参与代谢调控。然而，微生物细胞工厂在其代谢途径中缺乏能响应AD的有效转录因子。此外，寻找并获得天然特异性响应AD的转录因子是一项复杂且繁重的任务。在本研究中，我们基于结构引导的分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟，设计了一种响应AD的人工转录因子，命名为AdT。根据AdT与AD结合后构象变化的MD分析，一个N端和C端表现出汇聚趋势的配体结合域（LBD）被用作微开关，以引导DNA结合域lexA、连接子（GGGGS）(2)和转录激活域B42组装成人工转录因子。作为设计验证，基于激素受体的配体结合域（ligand-binding domain, LBD），在酵母中设计并构建了一种AD生物传感器。此外，AdT的变体F320Y的转录因子活性提高了1.44倍。总体而言，我们为AD微生物细胞工厂创造了非天然转录因子元件，并预期该设计转录因子策略将应用于与宿主细胞信号机制并行运行。
